changelog: FIX: Movies category mapping now normalizes and validates saved category IDs, preventing sticky/empty-category edge cases after provider data shifts.
FIX: Movies category filtering now uses strict normalized matching across all entry paths, eliminating intermittent zero-result mismatches.
FIX: Guide program selection now syncs focused channel row to the tapped program row to prevent highlight/program offset drift.
FIX: Guide left/right synchronized lists now use collision-safe row keys, preventing random row reuse/alignment slips on long channel lists.
IMPROVEMENT: Guide and Movies state handling hardened for re-entry and dynamic category changes under Firestick D-pad navigation.
